title: A moment to observe
intro: An optional guided practice. You will not be asked to share or write anything, and nothing you think is recorded.
safetyNote: You can stop at any time. If the exercise feels uncomfortable, stop and do something that feels steadying instead.

steps.title: Get comfortable
steps.text: Sit or stand in a comfortable position. Keep your eyes open or closed, whichever feels better. You can stop at any time.

steps.title: Rest your attention
steps.text: Let your attention rest on something simple: the sounds around you, or the feeling of your breath. There is no need to change your breathing.

steps.title: Let thoughts arrive
steps.text: Thoughts will probably appear. That is normal. When you notice one, silently say to yourself, “I am having the thought that…”

steps.title: Notice, do not chase
steps.text: If a thought is unwanted, acknowledge it and let it pass. If it is useful, you can keep it for later. You do not have to push anything away.

steps.title: Close gently
steps.text: Widen your attention to the room around you. Take a moment before you move on. There is no right way to feel at this point.

completion.title: You reached the end
completion.text: There is no right or wrong way to feel after a practice. If anything felt difficult, it is fine to stop practising and talk to someone you trust.

stopped.title: You stopped, and that is completely fine
stopped.text: Stopping is a valid choice. You can start again whenever you like, or leave it for another day.
